en.headline: Family of four hospitalised after Sha Tin estate fire
en.dek: Firefighters put out a blaze at Yan Chuen House, Shui Chuen O Estate, around 7.10am; about 140 to 200 residents were evacuated.
body: A family of four was taken to hospital on Wednesday morning after a fire broke out in a flat at Yan Chuen House in Shui Chuen O Estate, Sha Tin, police and fire officials said.

Police received reports around 6.48am as smoke poured from a unit on the 15th floor. Occupants tried to put out a fire that began in the living room but left with two cats when they could not contain it. Firefighters extinguished the blaze at about 7.10am.

The four residents, described as parents and two children, were conscious and taken to Prince of Wales Hospital with suspected smoke inhalation. Local reports put the number of people who left the block at about 140 to 200. The building was reopened later in the morning.
Preliminary accounts from the Fire Services Department and local reporting pointed to an electrical fault in a living-room air purifier. Officials said the cause remained under investigation.

zh.headline: 沙田水泉澳邨欣泉樓火警 一家四口送院
zh.dek: 消防早上約7時10分救熄15樓單位火警，約140至200名居民疏散，四人懷疑吸入濃煙送院。
body: 沙田水泉澳邨欣泉樓星期三早上發生火警，單位一家四口送院治理，警方及消防表示火勢已於約7時10分救熄。
警方約6時48分接報，單位冒出濃煙。住戶曾嘗試自行撲救，不果後帶同兩隻貓離開。消防到場灌救，約7時10分將火救熄。
四名住戶包括父母及兩名子女，清醒由救護車送往威爾斯親王醫院，懷疑吸入濃煙。報道指約140至200名居民疏散，大廈上午較後時間解封。
初步消息指火源可能與客廳空氣清新機短路有關，消防表示起因仍在調查。
